description: This file defines the SystemTargetGrainId struct, which is used to identify system target grains within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes methods for creation, parsing, comparison, and conversion related to system target grain IDs, as well as handling associated silo addresses.

classes.name: SystemTargetGrainId
classes.description: A struct representing a system target grain ID in Orleans, providing creation, parsing, comparison, and address extraction functionalities.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new SystemTargetGrainId with specified grain type and silo address.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new SystemTargetGrainId with specified grain type, silo address, and optional extra identifier.

methods.name: IsSystemTargetGrainId
methods.description: Checks if a given GrainId represents a system target.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a GrainId into a SystemTargetGrainId, returning success status.

methods.name: WithSiloAddress
methods.description: Returns a new SystemTargetGrainId targeting the provided silo address.

methods.name: GetSiloAddress
methods.description: Extracts the SiloAddress from the SystemTargetGrainId.

methods.name: CreateGrainServiceGrainId
methods.description: Creates a GrainId for a grain service with specified type code, system ID, and address.

methods.name: CreateGrainServiceGrainType
methods.description: Creates a GrainType for a grain service with specified type code and system ID.

methods.name: CreateGrainServiceGrainId
methods.description: Creates a GrainId for a grain service with specified grain type and address.

methods.name: CreateGrainType
methods.description: Creates a GrainType with a name prefixed for system targets.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the underlying GrainId.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the GrainId.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this SystemTargetGrainId with another for ordering.
